description.value:
Cyber City doesn't sell this status — it issues it, to the handful of buyers the shop has decided are worth protecting. You're one of them now, and nobody at the counter will say why.

Frequency once per day

Trigger You fail or critically fail an Install check performed on your own body.

Requirement Cyber City issued you Warranted status — granted automatically at 10th level, chrome-attuned.

Immediately attempt the check again and take whichever result you prefer — Clean Take (§01) still applies to the reattempt. The status is worth more than the reroll: the counter's Restricted shelf treats you as vetted, no introduction or favor required.
